content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I have a [product_name] [article_no] and tried to monitor my circuit diagram online, but I keep getting a message that the diagram on the device differs from the PC version. I was able to upload the diagram from the device to the PC and use it for monitoring, so I'm not sure what I'm missing. Is it possible to monitor online from the PC with this version? [product_name] [article_no]. Thanks.
I encountered a similar issue with a different [product_name] [article_no]. What solved it for me was installing the latest version of [product_name] software.

Hello, Which version of the software are you using? I'm not sure if the compare function is supported on your [product_name] [article_no], but it's available in [product_name] software versions V6 and V7. If possible, try comparing the offline and online versions through FILE / COMPARE. Let us know if this helps.
Always start a new project with CTRL+H to select the correct hardware, and make sure you pick the right configuration for your [product_name].

Typically, this happens if the hardware selected in [product_name] software doesn't match the connected [product_name]. In the software interface, check the bottom right side for an image of the [product_name], double-click it, and then make sure to select the same model as the one connected to your PC. If this doesn't resolve the issue, try updating the software to version V7.1.5 via Help/Update Center. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing challenges with online monitoring for a [product_name] [article_no], receiving errors about mismatched circuit diagrams between the device and PC. analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to monitor the circuit diagram of their [product_name] [article_no] online from their PC without errors. They hope for clear guidance on verifying and matching project configurations between the device and PC.
